verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI is itself a typed, official Python SDK for building agents, with model-agnostic provider support, structured outputs, tool-calling, message history, and an official CLI (clai) — all extensively documented and corroborated by community users building production agents on it. Missing for 10: broader independent benchmarking beyond HN discussion and more consistent hands-on validation of structured-output reliability across providers (some community reports of bugs with niche providers).
